zh.title: 上下文预算实验
zh.question: 工具返回的内容变多时，上下文窗口会发生什么变化？
zh.assumption: 只演示容量关系，不预测回答质量，也不代表真实 token 计数；模型本身不执行任何压缩或删除。
zh.observe: 观察：改变这个条件后，哪些信息需要重新取舍？
zh.footerNote: 示意数据 · 模型假设 · 对应来源

explanations.plenty: 仍有余量：高信号信息还有空间进入窗口。
explanations.tight: 剩余空间紧张：需要在历史与工具结果之间重新取舍。
explanations.overflow: 已超出容量：下方标出的溢出部分必须被裁剪或移出窗口，图不会把它藏起来。

en.title: Context budget experiment
en.question: What happens to the context window when tool results grow?
en.assumption: Capacity relationships only — this model predicts neither answer quality nor real token counts, and it does not itself compress or remove content.
en.observe: Observe: once this condition changes, which history or tool results would you keep, and which would you remove?

explanations.plenty: Room is left: high-signal information can still enter the window.
explanations.tight: Space is tight: you must decide which history or tool results to keep or remove.
explanations.overflow: Over capacity: the hatched overflow band below must be cut or moved out — the figure never hides it.

sourceRefs.title: Anthropic — Effective context engineering for AI agents
